data.body:
AC VERIFICATION AGAINST THE MERGED TREE — all 7 verified, then ticked.
Merged c6becbb2f. Verified by a held-out subagent that ran RED checks against the PRE-FIX source in
throwaway worktrees (not merely reasoned about them), then SPOT-CHECKED by me at each cited line.

AC1 errored pair excluded, guard reads `errored` not decision-vocabulary membership:
  parity.py:125  errored_pairs = sum(1 for a,b in gold_pairs if a.errored or b.errored)
  parity.py:126-128  decision_flips adds `not (a.errored or b.errored)` — reads the flag, not a
    membership test against the decision vocabulary, which is what the criterion demands.
  metric surfaced at parity.py:169.
  Test test_errored_pair_is_not_a_decision_flip (tests/unit/test_parity_bar.py:174) asserts
    decision_flips==0 AND errored_pairs==1.
AC2 RED-BEFORE-FIX ESTABLISHED BY EXECUTION, not inference: the merged test run against c6becbb^ with
  PYTHONPATH pinned to that tree FAILS `assert 1 == 0` — it did previously report one flip.
AC3 errored=True/valid=True covered: test_silent_errored_pair_is_not_a_decision_flip (:186), helper
  _errored_rec(..., valid=True) at :168; asserts validity.v2==1.0, flips==0, errored_pairs==1. RED pre-fix.
AC4 genuine flip still counted: test_genuine_flip_between_two_live_sides_is_still_counted (:197) —
  flips==1, errored_pairs==0. The guard does not over-suppress.
AC5 arms A/B/C non-identical: test_real_and_fabricated_flip_arms_are_distinguishable (:207) asserts
  len(signatures)==3 and counts==[(3,0),(2,1),(0,3)].
  CAVEAT RECORDED RATHER THAN GLOSSED: the signature bundles the gating strings WITH the metrics, so in
  principle it could pass on metric differences alone. The strings were checked separately and ARE
  pairwise distinct (A "3 decision-level flip(s)"; B adds "1 errored pair(s) excluded" + validity/
  error-rate lines; C has no flip line). Suffix logic parity.py:141-145. Criterion met; assertion is
  weaker than ideal.
AC6 offline re-score changes no metric: re-scored via provider_parity.recheck_recorded with ZERO model
  calls. Both slots identical to stored: standard flips=1, frontier flips=2, agreement 0.964/0.929,
  validity 1.000/1.000, error_rate 0.000 on all four arms, errored_pairs=0, gating_failures
  byte-identical. c6becbb2f deliberately did NOT touch provider_parity_results.json — which is exactly
  what "changes no metric" means. Detail for the audit trail: the stored metrics block has no
  errored_pairs key (the artifact predates the metric), and the pinning test
  tests/unit/test_provider_parity.py:326 compares only passed/gating_failures/decision_flips/n_gold,
  none of which changed — hence no artifact refresh was needed.
AC7 lint/typecheck/default selection: CI inference — merged through Gerrit, which requires Verified +1,
  and that gate runs exactly those. Stated as inference. tests/unit/test_parity_bar.py independently
  run on current main: 25 passed.
